entries.title: I Corinthians 16:1
segments: And concerning the collection for the saints, as I charged the churches of Galatia, so also you do.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:2
segments: On the first [day] of the week let each of you put by himself, storing up what ever he is prospered, so that there may be no collections when I come.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:3
segments: And when I come, whomever you shall approve by [your] letters, I will send them to bring your gift to Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:4
segments: And if it is suitable for me to go also, they shall go with me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:5
segments: But I will come to you when I pass through Macedonia; for I am going through Macedonia.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:6
segments: And it may be that I will stay with you, and even spend the winter with you, so that you may set me forward wherever I go.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:7
segments: For I do not desire to see you now in passage, but I am hoping to stay some time with you, if the Lord permits.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:8
segments: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:9
segments: For a great and effective door opened to me, and many [are] opposing.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:10
segments: But if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he works the work of the Lord, even as I [do].

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:11
segments: Therefore let not any despise him, but set him forward in peace, so that he may come to me; for I am waiting for him with the brothers.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:12
segments: As regards [our] brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not altogether [his] will that he come now. But he will come when he has opportunity.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:13
segments: Watch! Stand fast in the faith! Be men! Be strong!

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:14
segments: Let all your things be done in charity.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:15
segments: But I exhort you, brothers. You know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruit of Achaia, and they appointed themselves to ministry to the saints.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:16
segments: See that you also submit to such ones, and to everyone working and laboring with [me].

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:17
segments: I am glad at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus; for these supplied your lack.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:18
segments: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours; then acknowledge such ones.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:19
segments: The churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in [the] Lord, with the church that is in their house.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:20
segments: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:21
segments: The salutation of Paul with my own hand.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:22
segments: If anyone does not love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. The Lord comes!

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:23
segments: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:24
segments: Let my love [be] with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
